question: Simplify:**(1(2)/(5)+2.6)-1(3)/(4)**
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all mixed fractions directly into decimals for faster calculation.

1 ²/₅ = 1 + 0.4 = 1.4

1 ³/₄ = 1 + 0.75 = 1.75

⇒ (1.4 + 2.6) − 1.75

⇒ 4.0 − 1.75 = 2.25

**∴ The correct answer is 2.25.**
